user_story: As a user, I want to view my shopping cart so that I can review the items I intend to purchase. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The page title should be 'Swag Labs'. 2. The header should display 'Your Cart' using the selector [data-test="secondary-header"]. 3. The cart should contain buttons for 'Continue Shopping' and 'Checkout' with selectors [data-test="continue-shopping"] and [data-test="checkout"] respectively.
